Emergency Communication

تقرير الطوارئ

The formal communication and documentation of an emergency situation to the bridge, VTS, or authorities, following standard procedures.

Questions and answers

What is تقرير الطوارئ?

In this glossary, تقرير الطوارئ refers to: The formal communication and documentation of an emergency situation to the bridge, VTS, or authorities, following standard procedures.

How is تقرير الطوارئ used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "الجسر إلى جميع المحطات: ابدأوا تقرير الطوارئ عن الحريق في الطابق الرابع، قدموا تحديثات الحالة كل خمس دقائق."

تقرير الطوارئ matters because it supports clear communication in Emergency Communication contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.

Definition

The formal communication and documentation of an emergency situation to the bridge, VTS, or authorities, following standard procedures.

Operational example

Bridge to all stations: commence emergency reporting for fire on deck four, provide status updates every five minutes.

Localized term
